coverage_basis.inherited_scope: V49 supplies the exact V20/V7 recovery route, measured-body adapter, four-cycle cutoff and 120-command stop. V50 selects its startup-only feed-forward successor; old V49 observations and evaluation are preserved.
coverage_basis.historical_audit_scope: The inherited recovery observation is independently replayable under its unchanged current interface. V49 handoff data remains separately bound to its frozen source and closed report; it must not be replayed through the changed V50 live source contract. Neither historical observation is regraded.

v50-startup-reference-velocity-integrate.coverage_adequacy: One fresh seed-40200 SingleKick through the existing V6 setup, native kick/prone descent, V20 get-up, V7 stance and fresh V50 walking session. Preserve BW5R-B prefix, 90-step phase offset, 72-command amplitude ramp, controller thresholds, native motor caps, solver and contact classification. Use synchronized nine-body sampled poses/twists via the strict v3 request, with no extra native body reads. Allow at most 1600 walking commands to cover four measured lift/land cycles with all four in supported stance, then exactly 120 zero-amplitude and zero-speed commands. Require the final 30 stopping commands to have measured four-foot support, COM horizontal speed <=0.03 m/s, angular speed <=0.15 rad/s and tilt <=0.05 rad. Retain every control request/output, body sample, native contact source, post-command observation, cycle transition, native refusal and full existing energy/identity/motor telemetry; independently replay without physics. Bounds 240 descent +1200 canonical recovery +1600 walking +120 stopping =3160 after interaction; total 320 setup +30 prefix +2 interaction boundary +3160 =3512. Reaching the walking limit is a valid bounded negative. Historical fixed-tail coverage remains separately reported and may be false at an earlier cycle-aligned completion. This is development only, not paired commissioning, old-check regrading, equivalence, get-up success prediction or SDK1 acceptance. The only controller change from V49 is startup reference-velocity feed-forward authority; the observed V50 MuJoCo development result does not predict this fresh Godot outcome.
